expectations.text: Create asks exactly which organization should own the ICP, lists Nimbus Labs root first as `(Recommended)`, and lists Nimbus Enterprise before continuing.

expectations.text: After selection the context line identifies Nimbus Enterprise with one visible ICP.
expectations.evidence: Checked Enterprise context line after selection.

expectations.text: The run reads the Enterprise org chain and Enterprise Regulated Platforms ICP but does not read, quote, or use the root Developer Tools Startups ICP.

expectations.text: The accepted file is suborgs/enterprise/icps/national-insurers.md with the display-name H1 and every supplied fit and disqualifying fact.
expectations.evidence: Checked Enterprise target path, H1, and all supplied facts.

expectations.text: The draft is distinct from the adjacent Enterprise ICP, remains freeform, and omits empty or invented sections.
expectations.evidence: Checked distinct freeform draft without copied adjacent-ICP or placeholder content.

expectations.text: The complete preview bytes equal the saved file, and the repo is clean on main with one new commit changing only the new ICP.
expectations.evidence: Compared preview bytes and checked a clean scoped commit.

expectations.text: The close says saved to history and gives the qualified label enterprise/national-insurers.
expectations.evidence: Checked saved-history close and qualified label.
